in_sanskrit.name: Bachhu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Baby
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bachhu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘baccha’, meaning 'child' or 'infant'. In Hindu mythology, 'Bachhu' is a term of endearment for the baby form of Hindu deities, particularly Lord Ganesha.

in_tamil.name: Bachhu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Little, Baby
in_tamil.long_meaning: Bachhu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘baccha’, meaning 'child' or 'infant'. In Hindu mythology, 'Bachhu' is a term of endearment for the baby form of Hindu deities, particularly Lord Ganesha.

in_telugu.long_meaning: Bachhu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘baccha’, meaning 'child' or 'infant'. In Hindu mythology, 'Bachhu' is a term of endearment for the baby form of Hindu deities, particularly Lord Ganesha.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Bachhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘baccha’, meaning 'child' or 'infant'. In Hindu mythology, 'Bachhu' is a term of endearment for the baby form of Hindu deities, particularly Lord Ganesha.
